name: URY admin scope menu
describe: Company and branch dropdown opened from the header: 256px card, rounded-lg, shadow-lg, an uppercase title, an All row, a divider and the list; the selected row is primary-tint with a check.

Place under the header scope buttons (end-aligned, 8px gap) when a scope menu is open. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Plan", "Setup", the sample company, branch and department names and the sample date are translated here because ar.csv has no entry for them.
